items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: having Kenny Barron, Ron Carter and Lewis Nash play on my first album

ctx.x: Is that what brought these people to you who wanted to shape you?

Yeah, definitely. I mean I was a young girl. When I did the competition I was 20. When my first record came out I was 22. So you know I was very green and very naïve, and had this big voice, you know, and so everybody immediately saw all these different kinds of possibilities, and you know it’s the nature of the game. You know you come into these situations with managers and record companies and everything, and they see all this potential in you and they want to put their ideas to work with you. And that’s really…
Did you meet those musicians before the session?
